# Document metadata block

Every governance document carries a metadata block that conforms to the corpus's
metadata model. The check validates: all required fields are present; the Document
Type is one of the allowed types; the Version is three-part semantic version; the
Date is an ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DD` value; the Owner and Approving Authority are
role-based (a known role suffix or role stem, not a personal name); the License is
the corpus's canonical license value; the Repository Path is a self-referential
markdown link whose displayed path matches the file's actual repository-relative
path; and the filename prefix matches the Document Type. It also verifies the
metadata block's hard-line-break markers: each metadata line except the last ends
with a backslash so the block renders as a vertical list rather than a soft-wrapped
paragraph. A domain README carries only a loose header (Document Title and License)
plus the line-break markers. The metadata model is project configuration: the
allowed document types and their filename prefixes, the required-field list, the
exempt files and directory prefixes, the filename-prefix-exempt basenames, the
role-suffix and role-stem vocabularies, and the canonical license value are all
supplied by the adopter and are not part of this clause; a document whose block
conforms, and a file the model exempts, contribute no findings.
